svg.title: WebGL Academic Presentation: Highway Driving Simulation slide
svg.desc: Product shot of slide 5 of 6 at the /highway route: the sidebar with the 05. Application A kicker, the Highway Driving Simulation title, steering instructions, four arrow bullets and Back / 5 / 6 / Next, beside the WebGL stage where the looping highway model runs toward the horizon under a navy sky, with lane markings, grass verges, a median barrier and street lights, and the dark red Dodge Challenger easing toward the left lane.

g.text: Experience a real-time driving simulation. Use
A/D or the Left/Right Arrow Keys to steer the
Dodge Challenger through an infinite highway
